transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I'm here because the clinic got on me about how little I've been eating. But most days I'm just grabbing a coffee before my shift at the warehouse, and then maybe a yogurt or a few bites of something after my GED class. Sitting down for an actual meal just... it feels like it throws off everything I'm trying to keep in line.
Are you avoiding food because you’re afraid of gaining weight or because you feel unhappy with your body shape or weight?

Yeah, I guess it is mostly the weight. Like, if I eat something heavy... say, some fried food someone left in the break room, or a big plate of food at church... I just get really scared that it’s going to show on my body right away. I can't stop thinking about it once I eat it, and then I just really feel like I need to go check the scale to make sure.
Has your weight become significantly low for your age and height?

Well, yeah, my weight has dropped quite a bit. My work pants are pretty loose on me now, and people at the warehouse and the clinic keep telling me I look too thin. But honestly, when I step on the scale and see that number go down, it just feels like I'm finally getting somewhere. I just don't see why everyone is pushing me to put the weight back on when I feel like I'm making progress.
Have you been making yourself vomit after eating?
No, I don't do that. I just... I just try to control what goes in, so I don't have to worry about getting it out.
